title: madhuca penangiana
intro: Madhuca penangiana, commonly known as the Penang mahua, is a species of tree in the family Sapotaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits of acting as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Madhuca penangiana include its ability to inhibit the growth of pathogens, reduce oxidative stress, and modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
